meta.title: Monday Morning IPO Playbook: Sell or Hold?
meta.instagramCaption:
Monday Morning Listing Day Game Plan! Allotment mila toh profit kaise secure karein? 🚀📊

The 50-50 Listing Rule:
• At 10:00 AM: Sell 50% lot to pull out 100% principal capital
• Trailing Stop-Loss: Put SL at -5% under listing price for the rest
• Zero FOMO: Never average down a falling IPO on Day 1!

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily unbiased market breakdowns!

#ListingDay #IPOStrategy #StockMarketIndia #ShareMarket #Nifty #techwithgenz
meta.disclaimer: Educational content only. Not SEBI registered investment advice.

scenes.headline: MONDAY 10 AM: SELL OR HOLD?!
scenes.voice: Monday subah 10 baje share market open hoga! Allotment mila toh kya karna hai — sell karein ya hold?

scenes.headline: THE 50-50 MASTER EXIT RULE
scenes.voice: Master rule hai: Opening par 50 percent shares bech kar apni poori lagat safe kar lo!

scenes.headline: TRAILING STOP-LOSS AT -5%
scenes.voice: Bache huye 50 percent par listing price se 5 percent neeche trailing stop-loss lagao!

scenes.headline: IF FLAT OR DISCOUNT LISTING
scenes.voice: Aur agar listing flat ya discount par ho, toh hope me average mat karna! Stop-loss par exit karo!

scenes.headline: 09:45 AM PRE-OPEN AUCTION
scenes.voice: Subah 9:45 par pre-open session me buyers aur sellers ka volume order book me check karna sabse zaroori hai!

scenes.headline: FOLLOW FOR PRE-OPEN ALERTS
scenes.voice: Monday market open hone se pehle live IPO alerts ke liye Tech with Gen Z ko follow karo!
